title: Signature 28 · Hourglass SSBBW · Najeon · Bamboo Dawn
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her mid 40s, silver-streaked low bun with a mother-of-pearl binyeo.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — an overwhelmingly colossal bust, enormous round hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso and flaring far beyond the shoulders, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms, and a sharply cinched waist that stays clearly visible between them, with a soft rounded belly below the waistline that does not hide the waist. Huge, heavy, soft, unmistakably hourglass, not a plus-size model, not a shapeless round body, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Deep glossy black lacquer densely inlaid with thick cut mother-of-pearl shell pieces with visible sharp cut edges, flashing pink, green, and blue iridescent sheen, not painted, real inlaid shell. Large peony blossoms and continuous vines spread wide across the colossal bust and hips and narrow across the cinched waistline. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing full frontal in a wide stance, arms relaxed slightly away from the body.

Footwear: Extremely high black lacquer platform stiletto mules with mother-of-pearl studs. Nails: extra long stiletto, black with pearl tips.

Background & Lighting: A pale misty bamboo grove at dawn, soft white light filtering through tall green stalks, the background much lighter than her body, low sunlight carving the deep inward curve of the waist and the huge curves of the bust and hips, making every shell piece flash rainbow, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss lacquer finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
